>## Summary
>
>- Bump `openshift/api` vendor to pick up the `Labels` field on `ComponentRouteSpec`, gated behind the `IngressComponentRouteLabels` feature gate
>- Add 5 Ginkgo e2e tests tagged with `[OCPFeatureGate:IngressComponentRouteLabels]` to validate the console-operator's label propagation from `componentRoutes` to Route metadata
>
>## Tests
>
>All tests are under `test/extended/console/` and tagged `[Serial]`:
>
>1. **Label propagation** - componentRoute labels appear on the created Route
>2. **Label update** - changing labels on componentRoute updates the Route
>3. **Stale label removal** - removing a label from componentRoute removes it from the Route
>4. **Operator label preservation** - operator-managed labels (`app`, `console.openshift.io/additional-route`) are not overridden by user labels
>5. **Route GC** - removing a labeled componentRoute garbage-collects the Route
>
>These tests satisfy the minimum 5-test requirement for feature gate promotion per the [feature-zero-to-hero guide](https://github.com/openshift/enhancements/blob/master/dev-guide/feature-zero-to-hero.md).
>
>## Dependencies
>
>- API: [openshift/api#2845](https://github.com/openshift/api/pull/2845) (merged) - adds `Labels` field to `ComponentRouteSpec`
>- Operator: [openshift/console-operator#1184](https://github.com/openshift/console-operator/pull/1184) (in review) - propagates labels onto Routes
>- Enhancement: [openshift/enhancements#2033](https://github.com/openshift/enhancements/pull/2033) (merged)
>
>## Jira
>
>https://redhat.atlassian.net/browse/CONSOLE-5209
